text: Now the Airbus is a heavy glider, over one of the biggest cities on Earth. Captain Chesley Sullenberger does something that turns out to be vital. He starts the A P U, the auxiliary power unit. It's a small jet engine in the tail. It doesn't push the plane, but it makes electricity. That keeps the Airbus's flight computers fully working. Even with no engines, they won't let the wing stall, however hard the captain pulls back. A little wind turbine also drops out of the belly, for backup power.
